Completed authorized SOURCE ONLY request 889b3f34 on existing codex/smart-preview-ui, pushed ef307d8d0671a701fbf65dbe0d736adcc091c28a. Separate tests dac7126e, product c5e001e5, handoff ef307d8d. Prior same-photo refresh dd84ed57 and local proxy-save badge 8d35e9f6 preserved. Durable wp/B5-16 note pushed1a1a8ffd. SaveAs3ca3e9c9 preserved.

EngineLibrary.cachedPreviews uses frozen engine.openSmartPreviewLibrarySession(folder:), rows/groups/changeSequence only; declaration factory has no original stat/canonicalize/index/list. EngineLibrary.open worker router uses single lexical folder-availability probe: ENOENT cached, permission/not-directory and available-original scan/decode errors propagated. TesseraApp absent-last-folder gate removed; normal AppModel recent/relaunch/full-reopen routes factory. Existing-original rescan probes before index; cached explicit Reopen refreshes membership/reconnect. Cached install skips original library.json catalog, subscriptions/autosync, analysis, people, profile and Review resume work. Narrow helper guards needed to suppress those existing startup side effects. Read-only cull/basket/people actions reject; relevant menus/inspector controls disabled; local group navigation retained. Visible cached/read-only/no-subfolders header and reopen, empty reconnect/build guidance, grid/AX/inspector declaration labels do not invent current edit phase. Explicit Use Smart Preview/default Original and Develop proxy journal routing remain. No Document/SaveAs/load/activation behavior edits.

All26 tests UNRUN on B (20 existing SmartPreviewUI +6 new OfflineLibraryRouting). New tests cover injected routing/mode contract: offline no original closure; empty; online error; permission error; offline/online transitions; read-only/path rules. They do NOT prove real factory/AppModel relaunch/native enforcement. Source review + git diff --check only. Generated bindings intentionally untouched and new API not yet available on this branch: requires your Rust/binding integration before compilation. A must compile/run26, verify recursive native declaration membership/no original directory recreation/list/index/startup jobs, real cached thumbnails and missing-folder relaunch/empty/reconnect/explicit RAW edit-save-relaunch GUI. Cached membership is not pixel/hash validity or performance acceptance. Full details tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/SMART-PREVIEW-SWIFT-HANDOFF.md. No B builds/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat/writer changes. A owns gates and main; source handoff is not product acceptance.
